sections.title: 3. Design
sections.text_preview: The LinuxUartDriver component implements the design specified by the [`Drv.ByteStreamDriver`](../../Interfaces/ByteStreamDriver.fpp) interface.

sections.title: 3.1 Architecture
sections.text_preview:
The component consists of the following key elements:

- **UART Configuration**: Handles device opening, baud rate, flow control, and parity settings using Linux termios API
- **Send Handler**: Synchr

sections.title: 3.3 Receive Operation
sections.text_preview:
The receive operation runs in a separate thread:

1. A buffer is allocated from the buffer manager
2. The thread blocks on `read()` waiting for incoming data
3. Received data is packaged in the buffer
